test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.

I __called off__ an explanation for his rude behaviour.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'called out.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in Part (**called off**) of the sentence.
 
• The phrasal verb **'called off' **means to decide that something will not happen.(यह तय करनI कि कुछ नहीं होगा)
 
• The phrasal verb** 'called out' **means to summon someone to deal with an emergency situation; or to draw critical attention to someone's unacceptable actions or behaviour(किसी आपातकालीन स्थिति से निपटने के लिए किसी को बुलाना; या किसी के अस्वीकार्य कार्यों या व्यवहार पर महत्वपूर्ण ध्यान आकर्षित करने के लिए)
 
• Therefore, the use of 'called off' in the sentence should be replaced with 'called out' to make it grammatically correct.(वाक्य में 'Called Off' के प्रयोग को 'Called Out' से बदल देना चाहिए ताकि वह व्याकरणिक रूप से सही हो।)
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence:__ *I __called out__ an explanation for his rude behaviour.*
